description: Final classification call for a candidate long-range haplotype block. Assigns one of 8 classes describing the most likely architectural cause of the local-PCA / haplotype signal. The classifier consumes block_alt_evidence (Q7 alternative-explanation measurements) and existence_layer_a/b/c/d (Q7 inversion-evidence layers). This entry does NOT supersede hypothesis_verdict — hypothesis_verdict is the existence call (does the signal exist), block_classification scopes WHICH MECHANISM the verdict is about (clean inversion vs repeat-architecture vs SD-mediated vs CNV vs artefact). Atlas 2.0 extension.
question: Q7
source_script: TBD (to be implemented). Consumes block_alt_evidence + existence_layer_a (required) and existence_layer_b / c / d + hypothesis_verdict (optional, raises confidence).

block_id.description: Candidate block identifier; same id as block_alt_evidence.block_id and existence_layer_a.block_id.

class_primary.description: Primary class. INV_LIKE = clean three-cluster local-PCA (n_localpca_clusters == 3), HWE_FIS_pattern balanced_three_class, low TR / HOR / SD / CNV overlap, mean_depth_ratio near 1, low low_mappability_pct. TR_ASSOCIATED = appreciable tandem-repeat overlap dominates the architecture signal. HOR_ASSOCIATED = higher-order repeat / satellite organisation overlap; usually n_localpca_clusters > 3. SD_ASSOCIATED = segmental-duplication overlap; mechanism likely NAHR or paralogous-mapping interaction. CEN_PERI_ASSOCIATED = adjacent to or overlapping a centromere / pericentromere candidate (small centromere_candidate_distance_bp). CNV_LIKE = local-PCA cluster membership correlates with mean_depth_ratio anomalies. MIXED = inversion-like local-PCA signal plus strong repeat / SD overlap; deliberately picks no single mechanism rather than overcommit. ART_RISK = signal plausibly driven by low mappability / MQ0 / mapping collapse; should not be claimed as biology without orthogonal evidence.

class_secondary.description: Optional secondary class for MIXED-style blocks where two mechanisms have comparable evidence (e.g. INV_LIKE + SD_ASSOCIATED). NONE if not applicable. A block whose class_primary is MIXED SHOULD set class_secondary to a concrete class; a block whose class_primary is a concrete class MAY set class_secondary to NONE.

class_confidence.description: Classifier confidence in the primary class on 0-1. Not a calibrated probability — a normalised score reflecting how many criteria fired and how cleanly. Consumers should treat values < 0.5 as low-confidence and prefer MIXED in that range.

rationale_codes.description: Short codes naming the criteria that fired for this classification, for example ['n_clusters_eq_3', 'hwe_balanced_three_class', 'tr_overlap_lt_10', 'sd_overlap_lt_10', 'mean_depth_ratio_in_band'] for an INV_LIKE call. Aids audit; consumers should not parse the codes for semantics, only display them.

depends_on_blocks.description: Which upstream blocks were consulted to produce this classification. A defensible call requires at least ['block_alt_evidence', 'existence_layer_a']; without block_alt_evidence the classifier cannot distinguish INV_LIKE from TR / HOR / SD / CNV / ART alternatives and must not be run.
